responsibility: Implements parsing of the Rust front end’s `-frust-cfg` option syntax, accepting only `identifier` or `identifier="string"` forms and returning the extracted key/value pair for later conditional-compilation handling. Rather than hand-scanning text, it reuses the Rust lexer and templated parser to validate identifiers, consume `=` when present, and require a string literal value, and it also contains selftests that lock down accepted and rejected command-line forms.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation file for the cfg-option parser: it defines `parse_cfg_option` by wiring the lexer and generic `Parser<Lexer>` together and contains the CHECKING_P selftests. Its same-stem header only declares that interface and grammar, without the parsing logic or tests.
